items.q: [INTERVIEWER] "Baker," "Bakeef," we talked a little bit before... Then, "Moon Over Cuba" -- and that one says Tizol and Ellington.

ctx.x: "Baker," "Bakeef," we talked a little bit before, and that was after Mills, so that would've been with Temple. Tempo. Then, "Moon Over Cuba" -- and that one says Tizol and Ellington. That one you wrote alone?
